module: "Wizard" variant of the freeroam wizard: same flow as freeroamLevels (levels > level, vehicles > vehicle, options, multiplayer) but under the freeroamWizard root (title ui.menu.freeroamSelector.title). The hooks call freeroam_freeroamConfigurator.onWizard*.
notes: Route configuration module: it exports no function. routeManager reads it (via the ui_router_routes_<name> extension) when routes.lua includes it with `{ include = "<name>" }`.
The keys of `Children` form the segments of the dotted name: "<module>.<child>". `children` (lowercase) in a node designates its sub-routes; `include` mounts another module there.
`ui` is inherited by child routes (uiTypes, uiTypesFilter, infoBar, topBar, uiApps, uiNav, triggerPause): a child redefines it only for what changes.
No "freeroamWizard" module is listed in routes.lua: it is included only if another module includes it (the original freeroam entries are in menu.lua and pause.lua).

Root.desc: {title = "ui.menu.freeroamSelector.title", ui = Vue only, default infoBar, topBar and uiApps hidden}

Children.desc: levels (> level), vehicles (> vehicle), options, multiplayer; dynamic titles via resolveSelectedLevelTitle / resolveSelectedVehicleTitle.

ModuleName.desc: Name of the routes module (first segment of the dotted name).
